dc_title_s: Aerial Imagery for Monroe County, WI 2024
dc_description_s: This project established digital, 4-band orthoimagery services for Monroe County, Wisconsin in 2024 as part of the Wisconsin Regional Orthoimagery Consortium (WROC). Ayres Associates provided Monroe County, Wisconsin with digital, 4-band orthoimagery services in 2024 as part of WROC. The aerial imagery was collected on March 10th using a Leica Geosystems DMC III sensor mounted in a fixed-wing aircraft. Aerial imagery was collected to support 0.5 foot ground sample distance (GSD) orthoimagery to meet ASPRS Class II horizontal accuracy standards at  1 inch = 50 feet  map scale. The horizontal accuracy meets or exceeds 1.4 feet RMSEr according to the ASPRS Accuracy Standards for Digital Geospatial Data. Resultant orthoimagery was rectified to a DEM created from existing LiDAR collected in 2019. Orthoimagery was delivered in PLSS section GeoTiff and SID tiles and a project wide SID mosaic. The orthoimagery was delivered according to a PLSS section tile schematic. The project area covers approximately 908 square miles. Supplemental Information: The Wisconsin Regional Orthoimagery Consortium (WROC) is a multi-entity group led by regional planning commissions (RPCs) and WROC representatives from Ayres Associates. The goal of the consortium is to build and sustain a multi-participant program to acquire digital orthoimagery and elevation data throughout Wisconsin. Orthoimagery was collected for Monroe County in 2024 to provide consistent deliverable products and accuracy standards for each of the participating entities.
